question: Name at least three forms of corrosion.
idealAnswer: (1) Surface. (2) Intergranular. (3) Filliform. (4) Dissimilar metal (or galvanic). (5) Oxidation. (6) Pitting. (7) Stress. (8) Fretting.

question: Provide at least four examples of procedures used to prevent corrosion.
idealAnswer: (1) Cleaning. (2) Lubrication. (3) Treatment. (4) Sealing. (5) Inspection. (6) Installing protective covers. (7) Keeping drain holes free and clear.

question: Describe the effects of using steel brushes or steel wool to remove corrosion from aluminum surfaces.
idealAnswer: Steel brushes or steel wool must not be used to clean aluminum because steel particles can become embedded in the aluminum and cause corrosion.

question: List at least five examples of areas in an aircraft that are prone to corrosion.
idealAnswer: (1) Battery compartments. (2) Exhaust trail areas. (3) Bilge areas. (4) Vent areas. (5) Landing gear and wheel wells. (6) Fuel tanks. (7) Wing flap recesses. (8) Around and below galleys and lavatories. (9) Piano hinges. (10) Any area that can trap water.
